# hiok_diagnostic_setting (Resource)

Where a resource's logs, metrics and traces are sent, and for how long they are kept.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `resource_id` (String)
- `resource_type` (String)

### Optional

- `destination` (String) Where telemetry goes: otel (default), prometheus, jaeger or clickhouse — whatever the region runs.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `retention_days` (Number)
- `send_logs` (Boolean)
- `send_metrics` (Boolean)
- `send_traces` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
